annotations.title: Get a backtest loop's status and strategies

description: Where one of the member's backtest loops stands, by its id: its status and whether it is still active, why it stopped when it did, Quant's closing summary once it ended, its markets, how many strategies it found against how many the plan asked for, its attempts and the time it has used against its limit, its report_url, and what it found so far: `strategies`, its best ones (10 at most) with each one's id, attempt number, whether it meets every criterion, its in-sample score (0 to 100) and a line on what it does, and `best_strategy_id`, the first of them. Best means the ones that meet every criterion on every market, held-out data included, then the highest score; while nothing passes, it is the closest attempt, so say so. Read one with quant_get_backtest_loop_strategy. The member puts a strategy on a chart, compares them and resumes a loop in Vela, in the loop's Loop Report (report_url). While a loop is running, ask again no more than about once a minute. Requires signing in with a LuxAlgo account (OAuth).

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

loop_id.description: The loop's id, from quant_start_backtest_loop or quant_list_backtest_loops.
